title: When the Witness Turns
author: C. M. Yarrow
blurb: Astrid Ashgrove, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
